title: Shooting Stars
description: A twinkling star field with brand-tinted streaks shooting across at random.

a11y.motion: Stars stop twinkling and no streaks launch; one streak is painted frozen mid-flight. Both canvases repaint that still frame on resize and theme change.
a11y.screenReader: Decorative; both layers are aria-hidden, so only the content above them is announced.

examples.name: night-sky
examples.title: Night sky hero
examples.description: A dark hero with a horizon glow, dense stars, frequent streaks and a call to action.
